# GET /api/v1/user/actions/variables/{variablename}

Get a user-level variable which is created by current doer

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-135`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| variablename | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — ActionVariable

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `owner_id` | int64 | the owner to which the variable belongs |
| `repo_id` | int64 | the repository to which the variable belongs |
| `name` | string | the name of the variable |
| `data` | string | the value of the variable |
| `description` | string | the description of the variable |

- **400** — invalid argument
- **404** — variable does not exist for current user

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Variable name must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ and not start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix, and not be 'CI' | validation | !namePattern.MatchString(name) || forbiddenPrefixPattern.MatchString(name) || strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
| Variable data must not exceed 65536 runes | validation | utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength |
| Variable description is truncated to 4096 runes | validation | always applied on insert/update |
| Variable name is stored uppercase | business_logic | always on insert |
| Variable lookup uses uppercase name comparison | business_logic | opts.Name != "" |
